# Selfprint

> Selfprint interviews you, turns your answers into an editable personality
> model, and exports a persona file any AI can use. Local-first (no account, no
> server, encrypted on-device), works offline, open source.

## Key facts
- Price: free. License: open source (MIT/Apache-2.0, TBD).
- Where data is stored: on your device, encrypted at rest, with an optional
  passphrase only you hold. The project's servers never receive your answers.
- The interview needs a model. It can be a no-key model that runs in your
  browser (WebGPU), or your own API key for a hosted provider.
- Supported models: any Anthropic model (direct), any OpenAI-compatible service
  (OpenAI, OpenRouter, or your own endpoint), and an in-browser model via WebGPU.

## Pages
- [Home](https://selfprint.org/): what it is and how it works.
- [Privacy](https://selfprint.org/privacy): what's collected (nothing) and where data lives.
- [Terms](https://selfprint.org/terms): self-reflection tool, not therapy; model yourself only.
